### TAG-117: Geodesic distance computation via MeshLab

## Software Notes

Invoke MeshLab's geodesic distance tools and store the resulting per-edge distances as vertex metadata. This is the raw input the FPGA delay-synthesis math needs; NKS neighborhood queries can also use it for non-uniform CA neighborhoods on irregular meshes.
